props.title: Will Russia invade Georgia before the end of 2025?
props.details:
Russia’s invasion of Ukraine has heightened fears that they may target other neighboring countries. As part of Russia’s “near abroad” region (i.e., post-Soviet states) and with its internal politics in turmoil, Georgia could be a target for invasion by Russia.

Resolution

The question will be closed by the end of December 31, 2025. For the purposes of this question, an invasion is a significant deployment of Russian military forces (e.g., ground troops, armored vehicles, artillery, and/or air support operations) across the border into the territory of Georgia. The Russian forces must engage in offensive actions against the Georgia’s military, including armed clashes, bombardment of targets, or attempts to seize and hold territory within the country.
